import requests, sys, uuid, time

BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'

# Test: hnsw_ef=0 accepted without error (PoorDiagnostics)
c = 'test_ef_zero_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

# Create collection with hnsw_ef=0
r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}', json={
    'vectors': {'size': 4, 'distance': 'Cosine'},
    'hnsw_config': {
        'ef': 0,
        'm': 16
    }
})
print(f'Create with hnsw_ef=0: status={r.status_code}, body={r.text[:300]}')
if r.status_code in (200, 201):
    time.sleep(0.5)
    # Insert points
    points = [{'id': i+1, 'vector': [0.1*i, 0.2*i, 0.3*i, 0.4*i]} for i in range(10)]
    r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points', json={'points': points})
    time.sleep(0.5)
    
    # Search - check if it works
    r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points/search', json={
        'vector': [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
        'limit': 5
    })
    print(f'Search after ef=0: status={r.status_code}, body={r.text[:200]}')
    if r.status_code == 200:
        results = r.json().get('result', [])
        print(f'Search returned {len(results)} results')
        if results:
            print('[DEFECT: POOR_DIAGNOSTICS] hnsw_ef=0 accepted and search still works (silently ignored)')
            sys.exit(1)
else:
    print('OK: hnsw_ef=0 correctly rejected')
    sys.exit(0)

import requests, sys, uuid, time

BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'

# Create a collection first so list_snapshots has something to work with
c = 'test_snap_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}', json={
    'vectors': {'size': 4, 'distance': 'Cosine'}
})
print(f'Create collection: status={r.status_code}')
if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
    print(f'Setup failed: {r.text}')
    sys.exit(0)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Insert some points
points = [{'id': i+1, 'vector': [0.1*i, 0.2*i, 0.3*i, 0.4*i]} for i in range(5)]
r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points', json={'points': points})
time.sleep(0.5)

print("=== TEST 1: list_snapshots with collection_name=null ===")
r = requests.get(f'{BASE}/collections/null/snapshots')
print(f'Status: {r.status_code}, Body: {r.text[:200]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    print('[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] collection_name=null accepted')
    # Check if it returned something meaningful
    result = r.json().get('result', [])
    print(f'Result count: {len(result)}')
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print('OK: collection_name=null correctly rejected')

print("\n=== TEST 2: list_snapshots with collection_name=12345 ===")
r = requests.get(f'{BASE}/collections/12345/snapshots')
print(f'Status: {r.status_code}, Body: {r.text[:200]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    print('[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] collection_name=12345 accepted')
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print('OK: collection_name=12345 correctly rejected')

print("\n=== TEST 3: list_snapshots with collection_name='' ===")
r = requests.get(f'{BASE}/collections//snapshots')
print(f'Status: {r.status_code}, Body: {r.text[:200]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    print('[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] collection_name="" accepted')
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print('OK: collection_name="" correctly rejected')

print("\nAll list_snapshots tests passed")
sys.exit(0)
